**Roma defeats Lecce 4-0, extends perfect start with Malen on fire**
Roma dominated Lecce 4-0 in Serie A matchday 2, with Donyell Malen scoring twice to reach five goals in two games—a Serie A record not achieved since 1959. Soulé and debutant Rodrigo Mora also scored, with Roma now level on points with Serie A leaders.
